name: Отражение урона
subject: A dark iron breastplate visibly receives a small red incoming strike at upper-right, leaving a small contact crack and red flash. From that SAME received-hit point a thinner red/gold return energy streak curls outward back toward a small enemy claw at upper-right. Chest remains wounded so effect does not read as negating damage. No mirror shield, invulnerability dome or arrow diagram. Navy/crimson background.
caption: Полученный удар оставляет след на броне, а ответная энергия возвращается к атакующему.
